problems.issue: SetTypedArrayFromTypedArray step 10 (sameSharedArrayBuffer: IsSharedArrayBuffer(srcBuffer) and IsSharedArrayBuffer(targetBuffer) and the same [[ArrayBufferData]] block) is missing. The aliasing test is only `src_buffer == target_buffer` (object identity). If the engine can produce two SharedArrayBuffer objects over one data block, the copy runs without the CloneArrayBuffer step and does not behave as the spec requires. Either implement step 10 or throw agent.not_implemented for the shared-buffer case. Not observable from ordinary user code, so this is not a skipped observable step.
